variant.changelog:
# The Great Controller HUD Switcher 1.2.5
  - Add changelog window
  - Update to Dalamud API 15
variant.description: A simple tool to automatically switch between keyboard and controller hud's when pressing WASD or moving the left joystick. You can setup a macro to add the actions to your hotbar.
variant.name: The Great Controller HUD Switcher
variant.punchline: Toggle controller / mouse mode automatically or with commands.
